## Summary

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::ExpireDisputeTooEarly` — expire_dispute called before the dispute timelock elapsed.

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Wait until the dispute timelock elapses before `expire_dispute`; the sender can resolve earlier, but permissionless expiry needs the full window.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#disputed-an-overlay-not-a-status`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#disputed-an-overlay-not-a-status)
